data.description:
Welcome to a new world of wellness. Explore yoga, Pilates, and mindfulness in mixed reality with new classes added monthly to inspire your journey.

Want to practice by the beaches of Spain or the fjords of Norway? Our luxe virtual studio seamlessly blends your space with immersive environments for an experience unlike any other.

LIKE IRL, BUT BETTER
Our virtual studio maps your real surroundings for a next-level workout experience. Want to improve your form? Walk up to your personal 3D trainer to view each move from all angles or look over at your mini-instructor avatars as a guide.

FEEL-GOOD GAMING
Challenge your fitness with yoga and Pilates or hack your mindset with meditations and sound baths. You’ll level up your strength, flexibility, and balance with classes from 5 to 30 minutes. Unlock achievements for weekly and monthly class streaks.

REDUCE YOUR STRESS
Headset on, distractions out. Block out the noise and quiet your thoughts with ambisonic audio-guided meditations and sound baths set in elevated environmental landscapes. You can even change your backdrop to match your mood and stay in the environment long after class ends.

CREATE HEALTHY HABITS
Meet a daily wellness routine you’ll look forward to. Slip on the headset, step into a class, and see your strongest self come to life.

changelog.change_log:
What’s New

- We fixed a passthrough bug that was causing everything to disappear after taking off and putting back on the headset.

- Hands now adjust opacity during class to make your sessions more immersive and less distracting.

- Instructor bios are now expandable to let you dive deeper into their stories.

What's New

*We're always looking for ways to make your experience with Alo Moves XR even better. Check out the recent changes we made on the app.

*Improved stability - Enjoy smoother, more reliable performance so you can focus on class without interruptions.

*Video recording fix - Want to see a playback of your class? Now you can record your sessions from the Quest headset.

*New mindfulness classes - Explore a fresh set of calming meditations to energize your morning or relax before bed.
